data.one_liner: Generate color variants and modifications for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: The derived_colors package allows you to generate color variants such as light, dark, and inverted colors, as well as subtle color adjustments. It uses extensions on Color to calculate these variants inspired by Bulma calculations.
use_when: You need to dynamically generate light and dark variants of a given color.
You want to create hover or subtle color shades easily in your UI.
avoid_when: You require complex design-system token management engines beyond basic color calculation.
You need strict custom design palettes defined entirely manually without algorithmic generation.
strengths: Provides simple extensions on Color for fast variant generation.
Includes caching with WeakReference for improved performance.
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Limited set of algorithms primarily inspired by Bulma calculations.
No extensive theming architecture or configuration options documented.
